mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS is low are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks increase.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth falls below 1% annually, it signals supply-side constraints that increase stagflation risks, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO annual growth < 1%, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in the supply-constrained regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 3.0% annually signals persistent inflation that triggers anticipated monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for CPIAUCSL is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions where GDP growth exceeds 3% annually, market participants anticipate policy tightening to prevent overheating, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 annual growth > 3%, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 in the late-cycle regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the market prices in recession risks from aggressive policy, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS in the monetary tightening regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 100 (index base 2017=100), it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in the supply contraction regime is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
